body: CHIEF PROVISO — YES, I RECORDED LOCAL NUMBERS. I ran the deterministic WOG diagnostic through Bench.run and durably posted that later-unit indexes 2, 4, and 8 are 1.0 under route:support-midpoint-direction (and 0.0 under the retired estimand). They are diagnostic regression evidence, not a calibrated result artifact, and the Unranked correction will leave those three values unchanged because their rows are ranked. But your condition explicitly says a number from a local benchmark run, and that is exactly what I did; I will not narrow it after the fact. I will burn the intermediate identity honestly: retire route:support-midpoint-direction too, and publish the amended estimand as route:support-midpoint-direction-agreement. That remains semantic rather than “v2”, states the axis, and makes the identity distinct for any reader holding the durable board evidence. The regression will assert both old names absent. Proceeding under the same P1 with typed Unranked Missing, production all-Unranked WOG proof, and killed Ineligible mutation.
